messages:
Maya: quick UX bug: when reordering rules in compact mode the preview preview-scroll jumps and the highlighted conflict box loses focus. spotted on chrome.
Priya: ugh. does it happen only when the preview is visible or always?
Maya: only when preview is open and scrolled. apparently we scrollIntoView on reorder but don't re-focus the conflict node.
Sam: easy fix: after scrollIntoView call focus the conflict element and set aria-describedby to explain why it moved. small patch.
Luis: copy suggestion for the announcement: "Priority conflict focused: overlapping rules may not match expected traffic. Press Enter to open details."
Priya: prefer shorter: "Priority conflict focused 1 Open preview for details." Add an accessible label on the focus target.
Maya: also noticed the conflict badge uses low contrast in dark theme. we should bump to AA.
DesignBot: Checklist created: [aria-focus-on-reorder, aria-describedby, increase-contrast-dark-theme, persist-conflict-banner]. Linked to UX-4250.
Priya: ok moving to next sprint. thanks all :sparkles:
